usedFor: Mini Course Generator knows who finishes, and Microsoft Excel keeps the record when “Course Completed” runs “Add Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “Course Completed” in Mini Course Generator, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Each completion adds a row to your Excel table, giving you a running list of finishers.

watchOut: “Course Collection Completed” fires separately from “Course Completed”, so one learner can add several rows.
